outline: Some important mathematical preliminaries such as the variational method, etc. are introduced first to serve as the base of FEM. The procedure of FEM for engineering problems is introduced in both theory and programming. This course may benefit the students making a basic understanding of FEM.
schedule:
Week 1  Introduction
Week 2  Mathematical Preliminaries (I)
Week 3  Mathematical Preliminaries (II)
Week 4  Review of Elasticity
Week 5  Equivalent Integral Statements of Differential Equation
Week 6  2nd-Order D.E. in 1-D Problem: FEM --- Theory
Week 7  2nd-Order D.E. in 1-D Problem: FEM --- Programming
Week 8  Beams and Frames --- Theory
Week 9  Midterm
Week 10  Beams and Frames --- Programming (I)
Week 11  Beams and Frames --- Programming (II)
Week 12  Triangular Element in 2-D Problem --- Theory
Week 13  Triangular Element in 2-D Problem --- Programming
Week 14  Quadrilateral Element in 2-D Problem --- Theory
Week 15  Quadrilateral Element in 2-D Problem --- Programming
Week 16  Term Project (I)
Week 17  Term Project (II)
Week 18  Final
